# ORR certificate fixtures

Captured from RegattaMan's public ORR 2026 list and PHOENIX certificate
`h-472-2026-20930-17256-0-17` on 2026-09-30. The list retains the full PHOENIX
row and its original column headings. The certificate retains the Data,
Offshore Polars, Short Course Polars, Ratings and Line Drawing tabs.

Unrelated page navigation, scripts, login/session fields, glossary definitions,
images/canvases and presentation attributes were removed. Original values,
identifiers, labels, rating JSON, polar table headers/rows and notes remain.
The vendor's malformed `<thead>` markup is retained to exercise HTML recovery.
No logged-in request or browser script execution was used.

The reference certificate contains 21 list columns, 257 distinct fields,
61 ratings in five groups and four polar/allowance tables. Tests assert
independent published values, including GPH 577.5, Chicago Mac Upwind 0.9222,
Newport to Bermuda at 6 kt 881.0, and upwind allowance at 4 kt 1,446.8 s/nmi.
